label: FIP1L1::PDGFRA

sections.text: FIP1L1 encodes a component of the messenger RNA cleavage and polyadenylation machinery.
PDGFRA encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha, a receptor tyrosine kinase.
A cryptic 4q12 deletion joins FIP1L1 to PDGFRA and disrupts PDGFRA juxtamembrane autoinhibition, creating a constitutively active kinase. It commonly presents as a myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia.
FIP1L1::PDGFRA is highly imatinib-sensitive, with durable hematologic and molecular responses reported in clinical studies.
